payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative 2D DP on compressed color array; dp[l][r] = min turns to unify subarray [l,r]; uses space optimization with two rows for lengths L-1 and L-2; O(n^2) time.
payload.rationale: Classic interval DP for flood fill on a line. State defined on contiguous subarrays; recurrence uses subintervals [l+1,r], [l,r-1] and possibly [l+1,r-1] if endpoints match. Fits dp_interval precisely.
